question:
Select the most appropriate option for the given blank.

I don’t know why he _______ suicide despite being born into such a wonderful family.
solution:
The correct answer is: **committed.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"committed"** refers to carrying out or perpetrating a crime, mistake, or immoral act. In this context, it means to take one's own life. (आत्महत्या की)

 
 
• **Example: **He committed suicide after battling with severe depression for years.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Obligated **(कर्तव्यबद्ध): Having a moral or legal duty to do something.

 
 
• **Example:** She felt obligated to help her friend move to a new apartment.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Executed **(अंजाम दिया): Carrying out or putting into effect a plan, order, or course of action.
 
 
• **Example: **The artist executed the painting with great precision and skill.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: Pledged **(प्रतिज्ञा की): To make a solemn promise or undertaking.
 
 
• **Example:** He pledged to donate a portion of his salary to charity.
